text:
anna: Opening a PR to reorganize the Dedicated provisioning handbook. Splitting autoscale policies into its own page, clarifying eviction vs preemption, and adding a migration note for Dedicated -> Private customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4822

devin: I'll take autoscale wording & examples. Need to confirm metric names (p95_latency_ms vs p99). Will update the examples with a clearer target explanation.

samir: Eviction semantics: we should add a timeline diagram and show how fallback routing to lower-tier model works. Also add a short snippet showing `fallback_model: \"gpt-medium-quantized\"` in the policy.

mia: SLA table sanity check: row for \"reserved_pools preemption\" has mismatched numbers. Also cost calc section needs one worked example with numbers.

kevin: For migration guide, add a CLI example to reassign tenants and drain sessions. Something like:
```
redwoodctl tenant migrate --from=old-pool --to=new-pool --grace-period=300
```

anna: Here's a Terraform snippet for the provisioning example — please sanity-check:
```hcl
resource \"redwood_dedicated_pool\" \"tenant_a\" {
  name = \"tenant-a\"
  reserved_gpus = 4
  autoscale {
    min = 1
    max = 8
    metric = \"p95_latency_ms\"
    target = 200
  }
}
```

devin: Also adding a short Python SDK example for the quickstart section.
```python
client.create_dedicated_pool(name=\"tenant-a\", reserved_gpus=4, autoscale={\"min\":1,\"max\":8})
```

docs-bot: Automated checks: link-check ✅, spelling ✅, table-lint ❌ (SLA matrix row 3). See CI: https://ci.redwood.tools/4822

samir: I'll take the table-lint fix and add a unit test for the eviction wording.

mia: QA will run through the migration steps on staging tomorrow. Ping me when PR is ready for review.

anna: Plan: aim to merge by Friday EOD. If table fixes are blocking, create a small follow-up PR for wording. @devin @samir please ack by EOD :thumbsup:

devin: ack :thumbsup:

samir: ack :thumbsup:
